measure.contains.summary: Classify points as inside, outside or boundary of an analytic or native containment region using an explicit signed-distance boundary tolerance.

inputs.region: Containment region object with type: cylinder {origin,direction,radius,height}, ring {origin,direction,outerRadius,innerRadius,height}, box {min,max}, sphere {center,radius}, union {regions:[...]}, or body {ref} for a native BRepBody.
inputs.points: Nonempty array of [x,y,z] length-expression points (or {point:[...]} objects) to classify.
inputs.boundaryTolerance: Nonnegative length expression, default 0.01 mm; signed distance within this is boundary.
inputs.units: Length units for the tolerance (mm default).

limitations: Native BRepBody.pointContainment accepts no tolerance; signed distance is refined using minimum distance to the faces of a temporary body copy. If the SDK returns an unknown state or required data is unavailable, classification is unknown with a reason. A ring keeps its open channel: the inner cylinder is an exclusion, never filled.
Native checks use a temporary copy and do not create persistent test bodies.

measure.corridor.summary: Measure swept-circle clearance of obstacles against a centerline corridor; report occupancy, intersections, normal sections and limits.

inputs.path: Nonempty array of at least two [x,y,z] waypoints defining the corridor centerline.
inputs.radius: Positive corridor radius length expression (the swept circular section).
inputs.minimumClearance: Nonnegative clearance expression, default 0 mm; obstacles closer intrude.
inputs.sections: Array of {station,clearance?} arc-length stations for normal-section reports.

limitations: Geometric swept-circle clearance along a polyline centerline, not CFD, not a routing guarantee, and not a continuous-motion proof. Native obstacle bodies are not supported offline.

measure.region.summary: Report occupancy of an analytic control region by declared occupant points, per-section occupied-union area and limits.

inputs.region: Region object with type cylinder/ring/box/sphere/union (same as measure.contains).
inputs.sections: Array of {z:length} planes reporting occupant count and occupied-union area.
inputs.samplingBudget: Positive integer for union-area estimation, default 200000.

limitations: Occupied-union area uses a deterministic grid estimate; it is not an exact analytic union. Occupants are declared spheres/points, not native body intersections.
